relationships.subject: SCN9A p.Arg220Pro
relationships.evidence_quote: Functional analysis showed the p.Arg220Pro mutation altered voltage-dependent activation and delayed channel inactivation, consistent with a NaV1.7 gain-of-function molecular phenotype.

relationships.subject: SCN9A p.Arg220Pro
relationships.evidence_quote: Here we report a novel SCN9A missense variant identified in seven related individuals with stereotypic episodes of bilateral lower limb pain presenting in childhood.

key_findings: Novel SCN9A p.Arg220Pro variant in alternatively spliced exon 6A causes erythromelalgia with Nav1.7 gain-of-function.
Alternatively spliced SCN9A isoforms should be included in genomic testing of EM.
